claude.rationale: The registrant filed a Form 15 terminating registration on November 1, 2018 and filed no periodic reports thereafter, and its assets were absorbed into a separate registrant (W. P. Carey), so no separately audited outcome record exists for the 2021–2023 window. The slice explicitly states any realized outcome scalar for the acquired portfolio is not traceable to a separate primary filing and marks such items [UNVERIFIED]. With no documented post-deal trajectory for the product/process interface or the process/organization interface, neither p4 nor p5 can be determined and both are coded uncertain.
